scope: Forensic capture only. No write, repair, resize, repartition, or format was performed after the owner powered off the Pi and inserted the card in the Windows reader.

rejected_other_pi.reason: MAC does not match the authorized reference Pi.

bounded_conclusion.proven: V3 durably committed the target partition table, then its post-table reread aggregate identity check refused before e2fsck. Its FAT progress record made the stopping boundary observable.
bounded_conclusion.disproven_for_this_v3_run: A forced e2fsck timeout cannot be the reason this V3 transaction stopped, because e2fsck was not reached.
bounded_conclusion.not_proven: The individual identity field that changed, if any, cannot be determined from V3's aggregate refusal record.
bounded_conclusion.leading_hypothesis_not_fact: A transient /dev, sysfs, or blkid identity race during the post-table reread is the most likely explanation, but it is not proven.
bounded_conclusion.next_gate: Keep the card read-only after insertion. Retire V3 and do not retry or mutate it; a reviewed V4 fix with field-level diagnostic evidence is required before another exact-card trial. Milestone 5 remains unchecked.
